warfarin.message: Aspirin + Warfarin: Increased bleeding risk. Avoid unless prescribed. Monitor INR closely.

ibuprofen.message: Aspirin + Ibuprofen: Both NSAIDs together increase GI bleeding and ulcer risk significantly.

clopidogrel.message: Aspirin + Clopidogrel: Dual antiplatelet therapy – high bleeding risk. Only use if cardiologist has approved.

methotrexate.message: Aspirin + Methotrexate: Aspirin can increase Methotrexate toxicity. Avoid combination.

naproxen.message: Aspirin + Naproxen: Increased GI bleeding and reduced cardioprotective effect of aspirin.

alcohol.message: Metformin + Alcohol: Risk of lactic acidosis. Avoid alcohol while taking Metformin.

contrast dye.message: Metformin + IV Contrast: Stop Metformin 48h before and after contrast procedures. Kidney injury risk.

furosemide.message: Metformin + Furosemide: Furosemide may increase Metformin levels. Monitor kidney function.

dapagliflozin.message: Metformin + Dapagliflozin: Risk of hypoglycaemia and urinary tract infections. Monitor blood sugar.

simvastatin.message: Amlodipine + Simvastatin: Amlodipine can increase Simvastatin blood levels up to 77%, increasing muscle side effects.

cyclosporine.message: Amlodipine + Cyclosporine: Increased Cyclosporine levels. Requires dose adjustment and monitoring.

rifampicin.message: Amlodipine + Rifampicin: Rifampicin dramatically reduces Amlodipine effectiveness.

grapefruit.message: Amlodipine + Grapefruit: Grapefruit juice can increase Amlodipine levels. Avoid grapefruit.

clarithromycin.message: Atorvastatin + Clarithromycin: Can cause dangerous increase in statin levels, leading to muscle damage (rhabdomyolysis).

erythromycin.message: Atorvastatin + Erythromycin: Increased statin levels, risk of myopathy.

rifampicin.message: Atorvastatin + Rifampicin: Rifampicin reduces Atorvastatin effectiveness significantly.

niacin.message: Atorvastatin + Niacin: Increased risk of myopathy and muscle pain.

colchicine.message: Atorvastatin + Colchicine: Increased risk of muscle weakness and damage.

paracetamol.message: Warfarin + Paracetamol: High doses of paracetamol can enhance anticoagulant effect. Limit to ≤2g/day.

amiodarone.message: Warfarin + Amiodarone: Amiodarone markedly increases Warfarin levels. Requires 30-50% dose reduction.

fluconazole.message: Warfarin + Fluconazole: Significantly increases INR. Close monitoring required.

metronidazole.message: Warfarin + Metronidazole: Can dramatically increase INR and bleeding risk.

cephalexin.message: Warfarin + Cephalexin: May slightly increase anticoagulant effect. Monitor INR.

potassium.message: Lisinopril + Potassium supplements: Risk of hyperkalaemia (high potassium). Monitor potassium levels.

spironolactone.message: Lisinopril + Spironolactone: High risk of dangerous hyperkalaemia. Use only under close monitoring.

nsaids.message: Lisinopril + NSAIDs: NSAIDs reduce antihypertensive effect and increase kidney injury risk.

allopurinol.message: Lisinopril + Allopurinol: Increased risk of hypersensitivity reactions. Monitor closely.

verapamil.message: Metoprolol + Verapamil: Risk of severe bradycardia and heart block. Avoid combination.

diltiazem.message: Metoprolol + Diltiazem: Risk of bradycardia and heart block. Use with extreme caution.

clonidine.message: Metoprolol + Clonidine: Stopping Clonidine abruptly can cause severe hypertensive rebound, worsened by beta-blockers.

insulin.message: Metoprolol + Insulin: Beta-blockers can mask hypoglycaemia symptoms like heart pounding. Monitor blood sugar carefully.

clopidogrel.message: Omeprazole + Clopidogrel: Omeprazole reduces anti-platelet effect of Clopidogrel. Increases heart attack risk.

methotrexate.message: Omeprazole + Methotrexate: May increase Methotrexate levels and toxicity.

rifampicin.message: Omeprazole + Rifampicin: Rifampicin reduces Omeprazole levels, reducing its effectiveness.

clopidogrel.message: Pantoprazole + Clopidogrel: Less interaction than Omeprazole but still some reduced antiplatelet effect. Preferred PPI with Clopidogrel.

methotrexate.message: Pantoprazole + Methotrexate: May slightly increase Methotrexate levels.

fluconazole.message: Glipizide + Fluconazole: Can cause severe hypoglycaemia. Monitor blood sugar closely.

metformin.message: Glipizide + Metformin: Commonly used together for Type 2 Diabetes. Monitor for hypoglycaemia.

alcohol.message: Glipizide + Alcohol: Increased risk of hypoglycaemia and flushing. Avoid alcohol.

fluconazole.message: Glimepiride + Fluconazole: Severe hypoglycaemia risk. Avoid combination.

rifampicin.message: Glimepiride + Rifampicin: Reduces Glimepiride blood levels, may worsen diabetes control.

verapamil.message: Atenolol + Verapamil: Risk of bradycardia and AV block. Avoid.

omeprazole.message: Clopidogrel + Omeprazole: Significantly reduces antiplatelet effect. Use Pantoprazole instead.

naproxen.message: Clopidogrel + Naproxen: Increased GI bleeding risk.

antacids.message: Doxycycline + Antacids/Calcium: Antacids drastically reduce Doxycycline absorption. Take 2 hours apart.

iron.message: Doxycycline + Iron: Iron chelates Doxycycline, reducing absorption. Take 3 hours apart.

warfarin.message: Doxycycline + Warfarin: May increase INR and bleeding risk. Monitor INR.

antacids.message: Ciprofloxacin + Antacids: Antacids containing Mg/Al reduce Ciprofloxacin absorption by up to 90%. Take 2 hours apart.

warfarin.message: Ciprofloxacin + Warfarin: Can significantly increase INR. Monitor closely.

theophylline.message: Ciprofloxacin + Theophylline: Increases Theophylline toxicity. Can cause seizures and cardiac arrhythmias.

nsaids.message: Ciprofloxacin + NSAIDs: Increased risk of seizures. Use with caution.

warfarin.message: Amoxicillin + Warfarin: May increase INR. Monitor anticoagulation.

methotrexate.message: Amoxicillin + Methotrexate: May increase Methotrexate toxicity.

warfarin.message: Azithromycin + Warfarin: Can increase INR. Monitor closely.

amiodarone.message: Azithromycin + Amiodarone: Both can prolong QT interval. Risk of dangerous heart rhythm disturbance.

potassium.message: Losartan + Potassium supplements: Risk of hyperkalaemia. Monitor potassium levels.

nsaids.message: Losartan + NSAIDs: Reduced antihypertensive effect and kidney injury risk.

lithium.message: Losartan + Lithium: ARBs can increase Lithium levels causing toxicity.

alcohol.message: Pregabalin + Alcohol: Additive CNS depression. Avoid alcohol.

oxycodone.message: Pregabalin + Opioids: Risk of respiratory depression and sedation. Use with extreme caution.

benzodiazepines.message: Pregabalin + Benzodiazepines: Increased sedation and risk of respiratory depression.
